subject: Accounts info not populated when publishing apps through RStudio

messages.author: f294de09306522b8
messages.subject: Accounts info not populated when publishing apps through RStudio
parts:
I tried publishing my apps in shinyapps.io using RStudio. After the apps is launched locally and when I click publish, a pop up appears (pls see attached screenshot) but there is no way for me to key in the account. This despite Ilogin to shinyapps.io through a browser before trying to publish.

Is there any way for me to key in the account or populate the account?

Many thanks in advance !

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Accounts info not populated when publishing apps through RStudio
parts:
Bret,

Did you follow the instructions in the getting started guide?

http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/shinyapps.html

You need to copy and paste the shinyapps::setAccountInfo() command into your R console.

Hope that helps.
-Andy
